en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑framed elevated view over the rooftops of a historic European town. In the middle distance stands a white stepped‑gabled house with German signage on its facade, and further back are dense roofs, larger civic buildings and a church tower on the hill. The right side has a blank margin with printed red title text at the top and publisher information at the bottom.
